title: Tripgent
tagline: Tripgent — Chat with an AI travel agent, earn USDC for real engagement.Discovery that pays you back.
description: Tripgent is an AI travel concierge that flips the attention economy: travelers chat with an expert agent to discover destinations, neighborhoods, food, and local tips — and earn USDC when they engage with sponsored content. Instead of paying platforms for clicks and impressions, brands (airlines, DMOs, hotel groups) sponsor destination programs directly inside the agent. Every reward is tied to a confirmed action, not a vanity metric. Payouts run via Circle nanopayments — gas-free, instant, spendable. Auth and embedded wallets are handled by Dynamic, so travelers never touch MetaMask. A tier and reputation system (bronze → platinum) gates larger rewards to high-quality users. Tripgent is not a booking engine — it is an intent layer where user attention has real, measurable value and brands finally pay for it.
